hasAction.description: Decision D5: the meaning of the type (prefLabel, definition, subClassOf) is kept apart from the rest. The six-phase position moves from skos:broader to pp:phase (classification); profile, processDescription and provenanceClass move to a node of their own (pp:deployment); the openEO correspondences are grouped apart. The plan was already a node of its own.

subClassOf changes from https://w3id.org/ogc/rim/activity-type/ActivityType to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/generic-profiles/activity-type/within, the activity type of the operation in bblocks-generic-profiles (decision of 2026-11-10), with the same entity type(s): http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#Geometry.

The object identifier of this item moves from https://geolabs.github.io/bblocks-process-profiles/def/process-type/sqlmm/within to https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/sqlmm/within, which resolves through w3id.org (decision of 2026-11-17); the register actions of the item move with it, under https://w3id.org/geolabs/ospd/process-profiles/process-type/sqlmm/within/actions/. The old IRI is kept as owl:sameAs. The content of the item is unchanged. Classified clarifying: the item is the same, only its identifier changes.

definition: This service shall return a true value if and only if the geometry InputEntity1 is spatially within geometry InputEntity2; that is if every point on InputEntity1 is also on InputEntity2.

openeoEquivalence.rationale: No openEO process for this SQL/MM predicate in the published bblocks-openeo register.
